owner_directive: Owner-approved plan (e2e option 2): a headless end-to-end suite that starts a real 'scistudio serve' subprocess in an isolated home and drives it over HTTP and the /ws WebSocket, using the core tutorial assets (projects are built by copying tutorial assets, not via the tutorial session API). The suite is opt-in via SCISTUDIO_RUN_E2E=1 and runs on every PR as a separate CI job; the owner explicitly approved adding that job to .github/workflows/ci.yml.
